We currently ship to Germany, Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Spain, France, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Monaco, Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Czech Republic, and the United States.

For U.S. orders, the customer is responsible for customs duties and import taxes shown in the order summary at checkout.

turns.q: What's your warranty policy on defective items?
turns.replyTail:
overed by a 2-year limited warranty for manufacturing defects.

The warranty does not cover accidental damage, normal wear and tear, water damage, damage from impacts or liquids, misuse, or battery performance changes over time.

For a quartz or digital watch, submit a repair request here: https://icewatch.typeform.com/repair-request
For a connected watch or jewellery item, please contact customer service at info@bewatch.com with your proof of purchase and a description of the issue 👍
